race.comment: BLUE SPARX (6) finished off impressively at Belmont last time out to score by 0.7L in a strong maiden win. He looks beautifully placed in this event on the back of that performance and he maps for a lovely run. Ticks plenty of boxes and he can continue his way through the grades.  DON'T WINK (3) has been solid in both runs this campaign, missing by 0.4L at Belmont last time out. He looks primed to go one better third-up into the campaign as she steps out in trip now. HELLO VENETA (10) stepped up in trip last time out but faded out of contention at Belmont. Looks better placed in this field and Faithfull now hops on board. Maps for a lovely run in transit and can bounce back to her best form. GLORANARDO (2) was too good last time out and can repeat the dose without surprising. FENNEC STORM (1) ran over the top to score from midfield last time out and draws better this time around. Live chance once again.
